checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

wikipediaActualRead.title: Abarim
wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: 記事は聖書のAbarimをヨルダン川東方の山地として説明し、Nebōなど範囲内の高地を述べる。profileでは山地の全範囲を一点へ縮約しない。

geographyAssessmentJa: 広域山地候補として範囲を示す地図表示は可能。単一都市・山頂ピンとしては示さず、旧候補座標も未検証。
